newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo gains on diabetes drug hopes.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo gains on diabetes drug hopes.

text.p: Shares in Glaxo wellcome Plc rebounded from early weakness by early afternoon on Monday, in a delayed reaction to positive press comment on the stock, dealers said.

Glaxo shares were up 2-1/2p at 13.28-1/2 stg by 1329 GMT, even as the FTSE 100 index -- in which it is one of the biggest constituents -- traded 62.7 points lower at 4,814.4. Earlier, Glaxo shares had dropped as much as 18p.
"People called the stock lower because of the market trend but there has been some good buying on the back of decent press comment," said one dealer.

A report in the Financial Times said prospects for diabetes treatments troglitazone, being developed by Glaxo, Warner-Lambert of the U.S. and Sankyo of Japan, would be highlighted at a conference in Helsinki.
The report said analysts believe the drug will create a new global market worth more than one billion stg for the three companies.
